significance_rule.note: M5-M4 permutation p=0.017 is nominally < 0.05 but does not clear the Bonferroni-corrected per-comparison alpha of 0.01, hence marked non-significant. The bootstrap 95% CI [-0.0003, -0.0000] is also entirely negative -- a tiny decrease, not an improvement.

correction_note: Locked sections below (auprc_diffs, m2_m3_clarification, cadd_complementarity) are the pre-rebuild run: the feature matrix then had cadd_phred = -1.0 for all 60,521 rows, so M1 never saw a real CADD value. The M2-M1 (+0.0310) and M3-M1 (+0.0317) step-AUPRC gains in that run were a tie-breaking artifact: a 6,077-variant tie block (test SNVs with am_missing=1 and review_stars=1, verified from the feature matrix + splits) penalised M1 step AUPRC by -0.0321. Their "significant": true flags are corrected to false below; the step-AUPRC means and permutation p-values are kept as the locked record of that run. On the pre-rebuild matrix the tie-corrected gains were M2-M1 +0.0006 and M3-M1 -0.0002 (manuscript section 2.1). The rebuilt-matrix values are in tie_corrected and paired_auroc_diffs_rebuilt; step values are in results/benchmark.json (rerun 2026-11-08).

tie_corrected.method: Tie-aware AUPRC: expected average precision under uniform tie-breaking (McSherry & Najork 2008), function from scripts/18_exon_architecture_nmd.py. Models refit on train with the locked protocol (logistic regression, C=1.0, class_weight=balanced, seed=20261006) on the rebuilt feature matrix; paired bootstrap CIs, n_boot=1000, seed=20261006.
tie_corrected.matrix: rebuilt 2026-11-08, real CADD values (19,014 scored of 60,521)
tie_corrected.note: On the rebuilt matrix the tie correction is negligible (step vs tie-aware AUPRC differ by at most 0.0002): real CADD values break the 6,077-variant tie block, so the artifact that produced the +0.031 step gains is gone. Pre-rebuild tie-corrected values for reference (exon_architecture_nmd.json, model_comparison_test_24_genes): M1 0.8334, M3 0.8332, M4 0.8517; M2-M1 +0.0006, M3-M1 -0.0002. No permutation p-values were recomputed for the tie-corrected diffs; significance here is read off the bootstrap CI.

paired_auroc_diffs_rebuilt.method: Paired bootstrap CIs for AUROC differences, scripts/12b_paired_analysis.py method, n_boot=2000, seed=20261006. Models refit on the rebuilt feature matrix.
